map.输入 DFI 与 HDS 百分比，评估精子 DNA 完整性及临床意义。: Enter DFI and HDS percentages to assess sperm DNA integrity and its clinical significance.
map.DFI 与 HDS 联合判读。: Joint interpretation of DFI and HDS.
map.反复流产/受精失败评估。: Assessment for recurrent miscarriage or fertilization failure.
map.：DFI<30%（部分实验室<15% 更优）、HDS<15% → 均正常，DNA: : DFI below 30% (some labs prefer below 15%) and HDS below 15% -> both normal, with good DNA integrity and chromatin structure.
map.：DFI≥30% 提示碎片升高，反复不良妊娠风险增加，建议抗氧化与生活方式干预后: : DFI of at least 30% indicates elevated fragmentation and higher risk of recurrent adverse pregnancy, so antioxidant and lifestyle intervention followed by retesting is advised.
map.DFI 反映 DNA 断裂碎片比例，HDS 反映未成熟染色质（高可染性）比例。: DFI reflects the proportion of fragmented DNA strands, while HDS reflects the proportion of immature chromatin (high stainability).
map.常用 DFI<15–30%、HDS<15% 为正常区间，越高越差。: Commonly DFI below 15-30% and HDS below 15% are the normal ranges; higher is worse.
